about: The young nobles sent with the king's son weep and take counsel: they must leave Zion, the Ark, behind. Azariah, son of Zadok the priest, makes them swear secrecy by God, the Ark, and the patriarchs, then reveals that he can take the Ark: he holds the keys of the house and will substitute a copy built by a carpenter from leftover Temple timber, paid for by a collection of ten didrachms each.

sentences.n: Chapter heading; ፵፭ is the numeral 45. በእንተ 'concerning'. ዘበከዩ is ዘ- 'that which / those who' + በከዩ 'they wept' (3rd pl. perfect of በከየ); ወመከሩ 'and they took counsel' (መከረ). እለ ተፈነዉ 'who were sent' (passive ተፈነወ, from ፈነወ 'send'). sentences.l: And-sons-of princes-of Israel-indeed, who they-were-commanded that they-go with son-of king, they-counselled together while they-say: what we-do?
sentences.i: Now the sons of the princes of Israel, who had been commanded to go with the king's son, took counsel together, saying, "What shall we do?
sentences.n: ወደቂቀ is ወ- 'and' + ደቂቅ 'sons' in the construct (ደቂቀ መኳንንተ እስራኤል 'sons-of princes-of Israel'); -ሰ on እስራኤልሰ is a contrastive 'as for'. እለ ተአዘዙ 'who were commanded' (passive of አዘዘ). ከመ ይሖሩ 'that they go' (subjunctive of ሖረ). 'The king's son' is Menelik (ምኒልክ), here unnamed. እንዘ ይብሉ 'while they say' introduces direct speech. ንሬሲ 'we do/make' (1cp subjunctive of ረሰየ, whose last radical is -ይ; the -ሲ belongs to the verb and is not a question particle).

sentences.n: ወይእዜኒ 'and now'. ሀቡ 'give (pl.)', used as the hortative 'come!' before a 1cp subjunctive (the house rendering, as in ሀቡኬ below). ናቅም 'we establish' (1cp subjunctive of አቀመ 'set up', the causative of ቆመ). ኪዳነ 'covenant' (accusative). በባሕቲትነ 'in/by our aloneness' (ባሕቲት 'alone' with -ነ). ዘኢያአምሩ 'which they do not know' (relative ዘ- on ኪዳን); I take the relatives as subject, but 'who do not know our relatives' is grammatically possible. ንትፋቀር is the reciprocal tä-stem of ፈቀረ 'love': 'that we love one another'.

sentences.i: for God is here as well as there; may the good pleasure of God be done, and to him be glory forever and ever. Amen."
sentences.n: Source oddity: ብዝየኒ is written with ብ where I expect በ (በዝየኒ 'in here too'); flagged, read as በ-ዝየ-ኒ. -ኒ here means 'also, even'. ይኩን ሥምረቱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'may be his-good-pleasure to-God', the ለ- possessive, as in 'God's good pleasure'. The closing doxology እስከ ለዓለመ ዓለም አሜን 'until for the age of age, Amen' is the stock Geʿez 'forever and ever'. ፨ closes the princes' speech.

sentences.l: They-answered Azarias and-Elmeyas sons-of priests: other-indeed not-it-grieves-us concerning those-who they-hated-us our-relatives, but we-grieve concerning Zion our-lady, for they-cause-us-to-leave-her;
sentences.i: Azariah and Elmeyas, sons of priests, answered: "As for anything else, it does not grieve us on account of our relatives who hated us; but we grieve for Zion our lady, because we are made to leave her;
sentences.n: Azarias and Elmeyas are named here as sons of priests; Azarias will take the lead (next units: 'son of Zadok the priest'). አውሥኡ 'they answered' (አውሥአ). ደቂቀ ካህናት 'sons-of priests', construct. ባዕድሰ: ባዕድ 'other, else' with contrastive -ሰ; the verb that follows is singular, so 'as for anything else', not 'the others' (the plural ባዕዳን comes in the next speech). ኢያሐዝነነ 'does not grieve us' (3ms of the causative አሐዘነ, object -ነ; a 3pl would be ኢያሐዝኑነ). ዘጸልኡነ 'who hated us'. Source oddity: ያኀድጉነኪያሃ is written as one word, = ያኀድጉነ 'they cause us to leave' (causative of ኀደገ, with -ነ) + ኪያሃ 'her' (emphatic object pronoun); in the next unit the two are written apart. I read the 3rd plural as impersonal (?). Zion (ጽዮን) is the Ark, called 'our lady' (እግዝእትነ).

sentences.i: For through her they dedicated us to God, and we have been in her service (?) up to this day; and we grieve for her because we are made to leave her; that is why we weep so bitterly over her."
sentences.n: ባቲ 'in/by her'. አወፈዩነ 'they offered/dedicated us', the causative of ወፈየ, said of the fathers who gave their sons to the service of the Ark; the same verb returns in Zachariah's speech. ተልእክነ 'we were sent' (tä-stem of ልእከ 'send'); but ተላእከ 'serve, minister' would be spelled the same, and 'we have served her' suits sons of the Ark's priests (?). እስከ ዮም 'until today'. በእንተዝኬ 'therefore' (በእንተዝ + particle -ኬ). ፈድፋደ 'exceedingly'. ያበክየነ 'it makes us weep' (causative of በከየ), and so the cause of the weeping named in the chapter heading.

sentences.i: Then those others answered them: "Truly she is our lady, our hope, our boast, and our greatness through her promises. How could we abandon Zion our lady?
sentences.n: በአማን 'in truth'. ዛቲ ይእቲ 'this one, she' (an emphatic copula). Source oddity: ምክሕ ፡ ነ is split by a wordspace; I read ምክሕነ 'our boast' (ምክሕ 'boast, pride' + -ነ). ልህቅነ 'our greatness' (ልህቅ, from ልህቀ 'be great'; the sense 'growth/greatness' is uncertain (?)). ብፅዓት is 'promise, vow'; -ሃ 'her'. ወበአይቴ ንክል ኀዲጎታ 'and where/how can we leave her' with the infinitive ኀዲጎት + object -ታ, then ለጽዮን naming the object (the same anticipating ለ- construction as in ch. 44). sentences.i: And they swore to him by the name of God, the God of Israel; by heavenly Zion, the Ark of the law of God; by him who gave Abraham hope (?), by the purity and goodness of Isaac, and by him who multiplied Jacob and gave him as an inheritance a land foreign to him and to his seed after him.
sentences.n: መሐሉ ሎቱ 'they swore to him'. በስመ 'by the name of' (construct). ጽዮን ሰማያዊት 'heavenly Zion' echoes Hebrews 12:22 ('the heavenly Jerusalem'); here Zion is the Ark of the Covenant (ታቦተ ሕጉ 'ark-of his law', ሕጉ = ሕግ + -ሁ). The oath names the three patriarchs. በዘአሰፈዎ: በ- 'by' + ዘ 'him who' + አሰፈዎ, perhaps a causative from the root of ተስፋ 'hope' (?) with object -ዎ; the exact meaning is uncertain. ንጽሑ 'his purity' and ኂሩቱ 'his goodness', then ለይስሐቅ gives the owner (Isaac). አስተባዝኆ (causative of ብዝኀ 'be many'): 'multiplied him'; አውረሶ 'made him inherit' (አውረሰ). ምድረ ነኪረ 'a foreign land': Genesis 28:4, 'the land of your sojournings' (Canaan).

sentences.n: ሶበ መሐሉ 'when they swore'. አውሥኦሙ 'he answered them'. ሀቡኬ 'come, then' (hortative ሀቡ + -ኬ, as in ch. 2-8). ንንሥኣ 'we take her' (ነሥአ, subjunctive, object -ኣ). ዘከመሂ 'in whatever manner' (ዘከመ 'as' + ሂ). አየድዐክሙ 'I will make known to you': 1cs imperfect of አይድዐ 'make known' (as in ch. 31-32) + -ክሙ 'you'. There is no negative in the form (Geʿez negates with ኢ-; the አ- is the 1cs prefix), so I do not read 'I will not tell you'; he sets the plan out in his speech below.

The statement shows Azarias holds the keys of the house in his father's place.

sentences.i: Then Azariah said to them: "Do what I tell you, and we shall find it. Give me ten didrachms each, and I will give them to the carpenter so that he hurries to make me good boards and fits them together for me quickly, for the love of silver, to the height, breadth (?), length, and measure of my lady;
sentences.n: ወእምዝ 'and then'. ግበሩ 'do'. ንረክብ 'we find / obtain' (ረከበ). በበ ፲ 'ten each' (distributive). Source oddity: ዲድረክም here and ዲድርክም twice near the end; the word is the Greek didrachm (two drachmas), a coin; I keep both spellings. The carpenter is ፀራቢ here and ጸራቢ below (ፀ/ጸ variation). ያፍጥን ... ገቢረ 'that he hasten to make' (አፍጠነ). አልዋሐ 'boards' (plural አልዋሕ; the singular is uncertain (?), see the glossary). ያስተጣግዖን 'he fits them' (አስተጣግዐ 'join together'; -ን 3fp 'them'). ፍቅረ ብሩር 'love-of silver' (construct), i.e. the carpenter's love of money, which Azariah appeals to. ቆማ ወግድማ ወኑኃ ወስፍራ 'her height, her breadth(?), her length, her measure': the dimensions of the Ark; ግድማ is uncertain (?). ለእግዝእትየ 'for my lady': Zion again.

sentences.i: I will take them five at a time (?) unjoined, and there I will have those timbers joined (?) and set them in the place of Zion, and clothe them in the garments of Zion; then I will take Zion, dig into the ground, and set her there until we go off and take her with us.
sentences.n: እወስዳ 'I will take her/them' (ወሰደ); ዘእንበለ አስተጣግዖ 'without joining' (infinitive with suffix): the five boards are carried unjoined (?). Source oddity: ኣስተላጽቆን, ኣነብሮን, ኣለብሶን, ኣነብራ are written with ኣ (4th order) rather than አ; I read the same 1st sg. imperfect. ኣስተላጽቆን 'I make them cling / join' (the root ላጸቀ, 'adhere') with -ን 'them' (?). ዕፀው 'trees, timber' (plural of ዕፅ). ውስተ ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'into her place of sitting, of Zion': the throne-seat of the Ark in the Holy of Holies. ኣለብሶን 'I clothe them' with አልባሲሃ 'her garments' (the coverings of the Ark). እነሥኣ 'I take her'; እከሪ 'I dig' (ከረየ); ኣነብራ 'I set her down'. The plan: a replica Ark stands in the Ark's place; the real one is buried until the journey.

sentences.n: ወወሀብዎ 'and they gave him' (ወሀበ). Source oddity: ፻ወ፵ is the numeral 100 + 40; per the project rule it is read 'spoken ምእት ወአርብዓ (məʾət wä-ʾärbəʿa) one hundred and forty'. At ten each, this means fourteen contributors (arithmetic, not stated). ዲድርክም spelled thus here (ዲድረክም above). ጸራቢ 'carpenter' (here ጸ, earlier ፀ). አሠነየ ሎቱ 'did well for him' (አሠነየ, causative of ሠነየ 'be good'). በአሐቲ ጊዜ 'at one time' (perhaps 'at once' (?)). ተረፋተ ዕፀው 'remnants of timber'. ቤተ መቅደስ 'house of the sanctuary', the Temple. Solomon's leftover timber is used to counterfeit his Ark.

glossary.በአሐቲ: አሐዱ — with one (በ- + fem. numeral አሐቲ) · 'by one' (በአሐቲ ፍናው 'by one road')
glossary.በአማን: አማን — truth; በአማን 'in truth, truly' (በ- + noun)
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
glossary.በእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — on this account, concerning this (በእንተ + ዝ, preposition + demonstrative)
glossary.በእንተዝኬ: በእንተዝ — therefore then (በእንተዝ 'on this account' + enclitic -ኬ 'then')
glossary.በእንቲአሃ: በእንተ — for her, on her account (preposition በእንተ with 3fs suffix -ሃ, stem በእንቲአ-)
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people')
glossary.በዝየ: ዝየ — here (በ- + adverb ዝየ 'here'; the በ- adds nothing to the sense)
glossary.ባዕድሰ: ባዕድ — as for anything else (noun/adjective ባዕድ 'other, else, strange' + contrastive enclitic -ሰ; singular, agreeing with ኢያሐዝነነ)
glossary.ብዝየኒ: ዝየ — in here also (written ብ-, for በ- 'in' + adverb ዝየ 'here' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ተረፋተ: ተረፍ — remnants (noun, plural ተረፋት, accusative or construct)
glossary.ተአዘዙ: አዘዘ — command (3mp perfect, passive-reflexive T stem ተአዘዘ 'were commanded'; the T stem can also mean 'obey' (?))
glossary.ተእኅዝነ: አኀዘ — we are seized, caught (1cp perfect, passive tä-stem of አኀዘ, ʾ-ḫ-z)
glossary.ተውህብነ: ወሀበ — we were given (1cp perfect, passive tä-stem of ወሀበ, w-h-b)
glossary.ተዐድዎ: ተዐደወ — transgressing, overstepping (verbal noun of ተዐደወ; the final -ዎ is the verbal-noun ending, not 'his')
glossary.ተጐድአት: ተጐድአ — she was broken, wrecked (?) (3fs perfect, tä-stem; root uncertain; subject ሐመር 'ship') (?)
glossary.ተፈነዉ: ፈነወ — they were sent (3mp perfect, passive-reflexive tä-stem, f-n-w)
glossary.ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
glossary.ታንሶሱ: አንሶሰወ — she walks about (3fs imperfect, quadriliteral አንሶሰወ) · you walk about, you minister (2ms imperfect, ታንሶሱ ውስተ ቤተ እግዚኣብሔር 'you go about the house of God')
glossary.ታአምር: አእመረ — you know (2ms imperfect, IV, ʾ-ʿ-m-r)
glossary.ትእዛዞ: ትእዛዝ — his command (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', anticipating ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the command of God') · his commandment, as a plain object with no owner named after it (ዐቀብከ ትእዛዞ 'you have kept his commandment')
glossary.ትክል: ክህለ — you can (2ms imperfect, G, k-h-l)
glossary.ትፍቅድ: ፈቀደ — you will, you wish (2ms imperfect/jussive, G, f-q-d)
glossary.ኀደግነ: ኀደገ — we left, abandoned (1cp perfect, G, ḫ-d-g)
glossary.ኀዲጎታ: ኀደገ — leaving her (infinitive ኀዲጎት + -ኣ '3fs her' (written -ታ), accusative, ḫ-d-g)
glossary.ኅቡረ: ኅቡር — together (accusative as adverb; from ኅብረ/ኅቡር)
glossary.ነ: ነ — our (the suffix -ነ '1cp our', written apart from ወምክሕ in the edition: ወምክሕ ነ 'and our boast')
glossary.ነሐውር: ሖረ — we go, we will go (1cp imperfect)
glossary.ነሐዝን: ሐዘነ — we grieve (1cp imperfect, G, ḥ-z-n)
glossary.ነሢኦታ: ነሥአ — taking her (infinitive ነሢኦት + -ኣ '3fs her' (written -ታ), accusative, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ነቢረ: ነበረ — to dwell (infinitive of ነበረ 'sit, dwell')
glossary.ነኪረ: ነኪር — foreign, strange (adjective, accusative, agreeing with ምድረ)
glossary.ነፍስክሙ: ነፍስ — your soul, your life (noun + -ክሙ '2mp your')
glossary.ናቅም: አቀመ — let us establish, set up (1cp jussive, causative IV of ቆመ, q-w-m)
glossary.ንመክር: መከረ — we counsel, plan (1cp imperfect/jussive, G, m-k-r)
glossary.ንመውት: ሞተ — we die (1cp imperfect, G, m-w-t)
glossary.ንመውትሂ: ሞተ — we die also (1cp imperfect + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ንሬሲ: ረሰየ — we do, make (1cp subjunctive, G, r-s-y; the -ሲ is the verb's own last radical, not a particle)
glossary.ንትፋቀር: ተፋቀረ — let us love one another (1cp jussive, reciprocal tä-stem, f-q-r)
glossary.ንነሥኣ: ነሥአ — we take her (1cp subjunctive after ዘከመሂ + -ኣ '3fs her', G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ንንሥኣ: ነሥአ — let us take her (1cp jussive + -ኣ '3fs her', G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ንክል: ክህለ — we can, are able (1cp imperfect, G, k-h-l)
glossary.ንገብር: ገብረ — we do, make (1cp imperfect, G)
glossary.ንግረኒኬ: ነገረ — tell me then (2ms imperative ንግር + -ኒ 'me' + enclitic -ኬ 'then, now')
glossary.አልቦሙ: አልቦ — they have not, there is not for them (negative existential + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.አልዋሐ: ሊሕ — boards, planks (?) (plural አልዋሕ, accusative; singular and lemma uncertain without Dillmann) (?)
glossary.አርማሰ: አርማስ — raft (?) (noun, accusative; unclear, taken with ረመስ below (?))
glossary.አስተጣግዖ: አስተጣግዐ — joining (verbal noun, 'joining it', stem አስተጣግዐ 'fit together') (?)
glossary.አበዊነ: አብ — our fathers (noun, plural አበው, stem አበዊ- + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.አበይነ: አበየ — we refuse (1cp perfect used as a conditional after ሶበ 'when', G, ʾ-b-y)
glossary.አቡከ: አብ — father (noun, genitive after construct; + -ከ 'your', 2ms, form አቡ-)
glossary.አንሰ: አነ — as for me (1cs pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.አንተሰ: አንተ — you indeed (2ms pronoun + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.አእመሩነ: አእመረ — they find us out, discover us (3mp perfect used as a conditional + -ነ '1cp us', IV, ʾ-ʿ-m-r)
glossary.አወፈዩነ: አወፈየ — they offered us, dedicated us (3mp perfect + -ነ '1cp us', IV, w-f-y) (?)
glossary.አውሥኡ: አውሥአ — they answered (causative 3mp perfect, from ወሥአ)
glossary.አውሥኦሙ: አውሥአ — he answered them (3ms perfect + -ሙ '3mp them', causative of ወሥአ, w-ś-ʾ)
glossary.አዛርያስ: አዛርያስ — Azariah (proper name; here son of Zadok, high priest)
glossary.አየድዐክሙ: አይድዐ — I make known to you, I will tell you (1cs imperfect አየድዕ + -ክሙ '2mp you', causative Q stem as in ch. 31-32; there is no negative in the form: the አ- is the 1cs prefix)
glossary.ኢትንግሩ: ነገረ — that you not tell (ኢ- 'not' + 2mp jussive, G, n-g-r)
glossary.ኢያሐዝነነ: አሐዘነ — it does not grieve us (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect (3pl would be ኢያሐዝኑነ) + -ነ '1cp us', causative IV of ሐዘነ, ḥ-z-n)
glossary.ኢይነግሮ: ነገረ — let one not tell him (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms jussive, subject indefinite + -ሁ '3ms him', G, n-g-r)
glossary.ኣስተላጽቆን: አስተላጸቀ — I have them joined, fastened (?) (1cs jussive + -ን '3fp them'; Št stem of ላጸቀ 'adhere') (?)
glossary.እመሂ: እመ — whether, if (conjunction + enclitic -ሂ; እመሂ ... ወእመሂ 'whether ... or whether')
glossary.እመቦ: እመ — if there is (እመ + ቦ 'there is')
glossary.እመክረክሙ: መከረ — I counsel you (1cs imperfect + -ክሙ '2mp you', G, m-k-r)
glossary.እምቃለ: ቃል — from the voice, word of (እም- + noun, construct)
glossary.እምብዝኀ: ብዝኅ — from the abundance of (እም- 'from' + noun ብዝኅ 'multitude', construct ብዝኀ)
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun)
glossary.እምኔሆሙ: እም — from them, out of them (preposition + 3mp suffix, stem እምኔ-)
glossary.እምእዴከ: እድ — from your hand (እም- 'from' + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.እስራኤልሰ: እስራኤል — Israel indeed (proper name + contrastive enclitic -ሰ 'as for')
glossary.እቤለክሙ: ብህለ — I say to you (1cs imperfect + -ለክሙ 'to you pl.', b-h-l)
glossary.እወስዳ: ወሰደ — I take her (1cs imperfect + -ኣ '3fs her' (written -ዳ), G, w-s-d)
glossary.እዕርግ: ዐርገ — that I climb, go up (1cs jussive, G, ʿ-r-g)
glossary.እግበር: ገብረ — that I make (1cs jussive, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay')
glossary.ኪያሃ: ኪያሃ — her (accusative independent pronoun, 3fs; object of ያኀድጉነ)
glossary.ወሀቡኒ: ወሀበ — and give me (ወ- 'and' + 2mp imperative + -ኒ '1s me', G, w-h-b)
glossary.ወለአበዊነ: አብ — and to our fathers (ወ- 'and' + ለ- 'to' + plural አበው, stem አበዊ- + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ወለእመ: እመ — and if (ወ- + ለእመ, conditional conjunction)
glossary.ወለእመኒ: ለእመ — and even if (ወ- 'and' + ለእመ 'if' + enclitic -ኒ 'even')
glossary.ወለእግዚእየሰ: እግዚእ — and as for my lord (ወ- 'and' + ለ- + noun + -የ '1cs my' + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወለዘርኡ: ዘርእ — and to his seed (ወ- + ለ- + noun + -ሁ 'his')
glossary.ወልህቅነ: ልህቅ — and our greatness, growth (ወ- 'and' + noun from ልህቀ 'grow, be great' + -ነ '1cp our') (?)
glossary.ወመሐሉ: መሐለ — and swear! (ወ- + 2mp imperative, ወመሐሉ ሊተ) · and they swore (ወ- + 3mp perfect, ወመሐሉ ሎቱ) (G, m-ḥ-l)
glossary.ወመራኁትኒ: መርኆ — and the keys also (ወ- 'and' + plural መራኁት 'keys' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወመሳክዋተኒ: መስኮት — and the windows also (?) (ወ- 'and' + plural መሳክዋት of መስኮት 'window, opening' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወመከሩ: መከረ — and they took counsel (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, G, m-k-r)
glossary.ወሙላደነ: ሙላድ — and our kindred, birthplace (ወ- 'and' + noun ሙላድ 'birth, kindred' + -ነ '1cp our') (?)
glossary.ወምንተ: ምንት — and what? (ወ- 'and' + interrogative pronoun, accusative)
glossary.ወሰብአ: ሰብእ — and men (ወ- + noun; construct 'men of' in ሰብአ ቤቱ 'his household')
glossary.ወሰዐምዎ: ሰዐመ — and they kissed him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect + -ዎ '3ms him', G, s-ʿ-m)
glossary.ወስፍራ: ስፍር — and her measure (ወ- 'and' + noun ስፍር 'measure' + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ወቀተሉነ: ቀተለ — and they kill us (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect + -ነ '1cp us', G, q-t-l)
glossary.ወበህየኒ: ህየ — and in there also (ወ- 'and' + በ- 'in' + adverb ህየ 'there' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወበኂሩቱ: ኂሩት — and by his goodness (ወ- 'and' + በ- 'by' + noun ኂሩት 'goodness' + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወበንጽሑ: ንጽሕ — and by his purity (ወ- 'and' + በ- 'by' + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወበአይቴ: አይቴ — and where, and how (ወ- 'and' + በ- 'in' + interrogative አይቴ 'where?')
glossary.ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
glossary.ወበዘአሰፈዎ: አሰፈወ — and by him who gave him hope (?) (ወ- 'and' + በ- 'by' + ዘ- 'who' + 3ms perfect + -ዎ '3ms him', IV; root ሰፈወ and sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወበዘአስተባዝኆ: አስተባዝኀ — and by him who multiplied him (ወ- 'and' + በ- 'by' + ዘ- 'who' + 3ms perfect + -ሁ '3ms him', causative; related to ብዝኀ 'be many') (?)
glossary.ወበጽዮን: ጽዮን — and by Zion (ወ- 'and' + በ- 'by' + proper name)
glossary.ወተልእክነ: ተልእከ — and we were sent, or we served (?) (ወ- 'and' + 1cp perfect, tä-stem, l-ʾ-k; ተላእከ 'serve, minister' would be spelled alike)
glossary.ወተንሥኡ: ተንሥአ — and they arose (ወ- + 3mp perfect, Gt)
glossary.ወተፈሥሐ: ተፈሥሐ — and he rejoiced (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወትኩን: ኮነ — and let it be, may it be (ወ- + 3fs jussive)
glossary.ወኀሊወኢትኑም: ኀለየ — and think! and do not sleep (ወ- 'and' + ኀሊ 2ms imperative of ኀለየ + ወ- 'and' + ኢትኑም 2ms jussive of ኖመ 'sleep', written as one word in the edition)
glossary.ወነሐዩሂ: ሐየወ — and we live also (ወ- 'and' + 1cp imperfect + enclitic -ሂ 'also', ḥ-y-w)
glossary.ወነሥኦ: ነሥአ — and he took it (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect + -ሁ '3ms him/it', G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወኑኃ: ኑኅ — and her length (ወ- 'and' + noun ኑኅ 'length' + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ወንሖር: ሖረ — and let us go (ወ- 'and' + 1cp jussive, G, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ወንረክብ: ረከበ — and we find, shall find (ወ- 'and' + 1cp jussive, G, r-k-b)
glossary.ወንነሥኣ: ነሥአ — and let us take her (ወ- + 1cp jussive + -ኣ 'her')
glossary.ወንድኀን: ድኅነ — and that we be saved (ወ- 'and' + 1cp jussive, G, d-ḫ-n)
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአሠነየ: አሠነየ — and he did well (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, causative IV of ሠነየ, ś-n-y)
glossary.ወአርአዮሙ: አርአየ — and he showed them (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect + -ሙ '3mp them', causative IV of ርእየ, r-ʾ-y)
glossary.ወአውሥአ: አውሥአ — and he answered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
glossary.ወአውሥኡ: አውሥአ — and they answered (ወ- + causative 3mp perf., w-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወአውረሶ: አውረሰ — and he made him inherit (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect + -ሁ '3ms him', causative IV of ወረሰ, w-r-s)
glossary.ወአዝማዲነ: ዘመድ — and our kinsmen (ወ- 'and' + plural አዝማድ + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ወኢንናፍቅ: ናፈቀ — and let us not waver (?) (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 1cp jussive; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወኢንክል: ክህለ — and we cannot (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 1cp imperfect, G, k-h-l)
glossary.ወኢንፍራህ: ፈርሀ — and let us not fear (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 1cp jussive, G, f-r-h)
glossary.ወኢኮነ: ኮነ — and was/is not (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ወኣለብሶን: አለበሰ — and I clothe them (ወ- 'and' + 1cs jussive + -ን '3fp them', causative IV of ለበሰ, l-b-s)
glossary.ወኣነብራ: አነበረ — and I set her (ወ- 'and' + 1cs jussive + -ኣ '3fs her', causative IV of ነበረ, n-b-r)
glossary.ወኣነብሮን: አነበረ — and I set them (ወ- 'and' + 1cs jussive + -ን '3fp them', causative IV of ነበረ, n-b-r)
glossary.ወኤልሚያስ: ኤልሚያስ — and Elmeyas (ወ- 'and' + proper name, a companion of Azarias)
glossary.ወእሁቦ: ወሀበ — and I give him (ወ- 'and' + 1cs imperfect + -ሁ '3ms him', G, w-h-b)
glossary.ወእመሂ: እመ — and whether, or whether (ወ- 'and' + conjunction እመ + enclitic -ሂ)
glossary.ወእምትእዛዘ: ትእዛዝ — and from the command of (ወ- + እም- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወእብሎ: ብህለ — and I say to him (ወ- 'and' + 1cs imperfect + -ሎ 'to him', b-h-l)
glossary.ወእነሥኣ: ነሥአ — and I take her (ወ- 'and' + 1cs jussive + -ኣ '3fs her', G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወእከሪ: ከረየ — and I dig (ወ- 'and' + 1cs jussive, G, k-r-y) (?)
glossary.ወካህናትኒ: ካህን — and the priests also (ወ- + plural ካህናት + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወወሀብዎ: ወሀበ — and they gave him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G + -ዎ 'him')
glossary.ወወሀቦ: ወሀበ — and he gave him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-h-b + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወዐይኖ: ዐይን — and his eyes (ወ- 'and' + noun, sg. or dual sense + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወዘከመሂ: ዘከመ — and however, in whatever way (ወ- 'and' + ዘከመ 'as, how' + enclitic -ሂ)
glossary.ወያስተጣግዖን: አስተጣግዐ — and that he fit them together (ወ- 'and' + 3ms jussive + -ዎን '3fp them', Q/Št stem 'join, fit') (?)
glossary.ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤልዎሙ: ብህለ — and they said to them (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይኩን: ኮነ — and may it be (ወ- 'and' + 3ms jussive, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ወይጐነዲ: ጐነደየ — and he oppresses (?) (ወ- 'and' + 3ms imperfect; root and sense uncertain, unclear) (?)
glossary.ወደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — and sons of (ወ- 'and' + plural construct)
glossary.ወገብሩ: ገብረ — and they made, amounted to (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወገጾ: ገጽ — and his face (ወ- 'and' + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወግበሩ: ገብረ — and do! (ወ- 'and' + 2mp imperative, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወግድማ: ግድም — and her breadth (?) (ወ- 'and' + noun, sense uncertain + -ሃ '3fs her') (?)
glossary.ወፃእነ: ወጽአ — and we go out (ወ- 'and' + 1cp perfect used as a conditional, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ዓመት: ዓመት — year (noun, fem.; after a numeral)
glossary.ዘስሙ: ስም — whose name (ዘ- relative + noun 'name' + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ዘበከዩ: በከየ — that they wept (ዘ- 'that which' + 3mp perfect, G, b-k-y)
glossary.ዘቤተ: ቤት — of the house of (ዘ- 'of, that of' + ቤተ, construct 'house of')
glossary.ዘንገብር: ገብረ — what we should do (ዘ- 'what' + 1cp imperfect/jussive, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ዘአምከርከነ: መከረ — what you counselled us (ዘ- 'what' + 2ms perfect, IV አምከረ + -ነ '1cp us', m-k-r)
glossary.ዘአነ: አነ — what I (ዘ- 'that which' + pronoun አነ 'I')
glossary.ዘኢያአምሩ: አእመረ — which they do not know (ዘ- 'which' + ኢ- 'not' + 3mp imperfect, IV, ʾ-ʿ-m-r)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered')
glossary.ዘይበውኡ: ቦአ — who enter (ዘ- 'who' + 3mp imperfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ዘይጔጒእ: ጐጕአ — who disturbs, stirs up (?) (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms imperfect; root and sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዘገብረ: ገብረ — what he did (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, g-b-r)
glossary.ዘጸልኡነ: ጸልአ — those who hated us (ዘ- 'who' + 3mp perfect + -ነ '1cp us', G, ṣ-l-ʾ)
glossary.ዘፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — what he wished (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect)
glossary.ዚአሃ: ዚአ — hers, of her (possessive ዚአ + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ያበክየነ: አበከየ — he makes us weep (3ms imperfect + -ነ '1cp us', causative IV of በከየ, b-k-y)
glossary.ያኀድጉነ: አኀደገ — they cause us to leave (3mp imperfect + -ነ '1cp us', causative IV of ኀደገ, ḫ-d-g (?))
glossary.ያኀድጉነኪያሃ: አኀደገ — they cause us to leave her (3mp imperfect + -ነ '1cp us' + ኪያሃ 'her', causative IV of ኀደገ, ḫ-d-g (?))
glossary.ያፍጥን: አፍጠነ — that he hurry (3ms jussive, IV, f-ṭ-n)
glossary.ይሡዕ: ሦዐ — he sacrifices, that he sacrifice (3ms jussive, G, ś-w-ʿ)
glossary.ይቀትለነ: ቀተለ — he kills us (3ms imperfect + -ነ '1cp us', G, q-t-l)
glossary.ይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — he said to them (3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ይብሉ: ብህለ — they say (3mp subjunctive/imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying')
glossary.ይንሥኡ: ነሥአ — they take (3mp jussive, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father')
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ዲድረክም: ዲድረክም — didrachm, a two-drachma coin (noun, Greek loanword δίδραχμον)
glossary.ዲድርክም: ዲድረክም — didrachm, a two-drachma coin (noun, variant spelling of ዲድረክም)
glossary.ገቢረ: ገብረ — to do, doing (infinitive/verbal noun of ገብረ, accusative)
glossary.ጠይቅ: ጠየቀ — examine, investigate (2ms imperative, G, ṭ-y-q)
glossary.ፀአተ: ፀአት — departure, going out (noun, construct 'departure of'; ፀአተ ነፍስ 'departure of the soul', death)
glossary.ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ፍቅድ: ፈቀደ — wish! resolve! (?) (2ms imperative, G, f-q-d; not the noun ፍቅድ 'will')
glossary.ፍጡነ: ፍጡን — quick, quickly (adjective, accusative as adverb)
glossary.፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants')
glossary.፵፭: ፵፭ — numeral 45, chapter number; spoken አርብዓ ወኀምስቱ (ʾärbəʿa wä-ḫaməstu) 'forty-five' (numeral)
glossary.፻ወ፵: ፻ወ፵ — numeral 140, spoken ምእት ወአርብዓ (məʾət wä-ʾärbəʿa) 'one hundred and forty' (numeral)
